verbs.name: help
verbs.summary: show detailed documentation for all verbs or a single named verb

verbs.name: list_calendars
verbs.summary: list all calendars accessible to the authenticated user

verbs.name: list_events
verbs.summary: list events in a time window; expands recurring events into occurrences

verbs.name: get_event
verbs.summary: get full event details by ID; bodyPreview by default, full body via output=raw

verbs.name: search_events
verbs.summary: search events by subject, date range, importance, sensitivity, and other filters

verbs.name: create_event
verbs.summary: create a personal calendar event (no attendees); use create_meeting for meetings

verbs.name: update_event
verbs.summary: update a personal event (PATCH); use update_meeting to change attendees

verbs.name: delete_event
verbs.summary: permanently delete an event by ID (organizer deletions notify attendees)

verbs.name: respond_event
verbs.summary: accept, tentatively accept, or decline an invitation; notifies organizer

verbs.name: reschedule_event
verbs.summary: move a personal event to a new start time, preserving its original duration

verbs.name: create_meeting
verbs.summary: create a meeting with attendees; sends invitations; confirm with user first

verbs.name: update_meeting
verbs.summary: update a meeting including attendee changes; sends notifications; confirm first

verbs.name: cancel_meeting
verbs.summary: cancel a meeting and notify attendees; organizer only; confirm with user first

verbs.name: reschedule_meeting
verbs.summary: move a meeting to a new start time, preserving duration; notifies attendees

verbs.name: get_free_busy
verbs.summary: get free/busy availability for a time range; returns busy periods with times

verbs.name: help
verbs.summary: show detailed documentation for all verbs or a single named verb

verbs.name: list_folders
verbs.summary: list mail folders (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, etc.) with unread and total counts

verbs.name: list_messages
verbs.summary: list messages in a folder or across all folders; filter by date, sender, thread

verbs.name: get_message
verbs.summary: get full message details by ID; bodyPreview by default, full body via output=raw

verbs.name: search_messages
verbs.summary: full-text KQL search across messages; ranked by relevance, not chronologically

verbs.name: get_conversation
verbs.summary: retrieve all messages in an email thread in chronological order

verbs.name: list_attachments
verbs.summary: list attachment metadata (id, name, contentType, size) for a message

verbs.name: get_attachment
verbs.summary: download an attachment; returns metadata and base64 content up to the size limit

verbs.name: create_draft
verbs.summary: create a new email draft in the Drafts folder (not sent automatically)

verbs.name: create_reply_draft
verbs.summary: create a reply draft to an existing message preserving threading headers

verbs.name: create_forward_draft
verbs.summary: create a forward draft of an existing message with new recipients

verbs.name: update_draft
verbs.summary: update draft fields (PATCH semantics; non-draft messages rejected)

verbs.name: delete_draft
verbs.summary: permanently delete a draft message (irreversible; non-draft messages rejected)

verbs.name: help
verbs.summary: show detailed documentation for all verbs or a single named verb

verbs.name: add
verbs.summary: add and authenticate a new Microsoft account (browser/device_code/auth_code)

verbs.name: remove
verbs.summary: remove an account from the registry and clear its tokens (irreversible)

verbs.name: list
verbs.summary: list all registered accounts with label, UPN, state, and auth_method

verbs.name: login
verbs.summary: re-authenticate a disconnected account without removing it

verbs.name: logout
verbs.summary: disconnect an account without removing it; preserves config for login

verbs.name: refresh
verbs.summary: force a token refresh for an authenticated account; returns new expiry

verbs.name: help
verbs.summary: show detailed documentation for all verbs or a single named verb

verbs.name: about
verbs.summary: return build identity and host environment metadata for troubleshooting

verbs.name: status
verbs.summary: return server health: version, accounts, uptime, config (no Graph call)

verbs.name: list_docs
verbs.summary: list embedded documentation: slug, title, summary, tags, size, and doc:// URI

verbs.name: search_docs
verbs.summary: search embedded docs by keyword; returns ranked snippets with line numbers

verbs.name: get_docs
verbs.summary: fetch a document or section by slug; use search_docs first to identify the slug

verbs.name: complete_auth
verbs.summary: exchange browser redirect URL for tokens to finish auth_code flow

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_CLIENT_ID
config.description: OAuth client (application) ID, or a well-known client name, used for authentication.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_TENANT_ID
config.description: Entra ID tenant: common, organizations, consumers, or a specific tenant GUID.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_AUTH_RECORD_PATH
config.description: Filesystem path where the non-secret authentication record is persisted.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_CACHE_NAME
config.description: Partition name for the OS-native persistent token cache.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
config.description: IANA timezone for calendar operations when the caller omits one; 'auto' detects the host timezone.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
config.description: Minimum log severity: debug, info, warn, or error.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
config.description: Structured log output format: json or text.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_MAX_RETRIES
config.description: Maximum retry attempts for transient Graph API failures (range 0-10).

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS
config.description: Initial exponential-backoff duration in milliseconds for retryable Graph errors (range 100-30000).

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
config.description: Maximum duration in seconds for a single Graph API request (range 1-300).

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
config.description: Maximum duration in seconds to wait for in-flight requests after a shutdown signal (range 1-300).

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_LOG_SANITIZE
config.description: Mask PII such as email addresses and body content in log output.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_AUDIT_LOG_ENABLED
config.description: Emit a structured audit entry for every tool invocation.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_AUDIT_LOG_PATH
config.description: Filesystem path for the audit log file; empty writes audit entries to stderr.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_READ_ONLY
config.description: Disable all write operations, registering only read verbs.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_OTEL_ENABLED
config.description: Enable OpenTelemetry metrics and tracing.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_OTEL_ENDPOINT
config.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint for exporting telemetry; empty resolves to localhost:4317 at startup.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
config.description: service.name resource attribute for OpenTelemetry telemetry.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_LOG_FILE
config.description: Optional filesystem path for log file output in addition to stderr.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_AUTH_METHOD
config.description: Authentication method: device_code, browser, or auth_code; empty infers from the client ID.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_ACCOUNTS_PATH
config.description: Filesystem path for the accounts.json registry; empty derives it from the auth record directory.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_TOKEN_STORAGE
config.description: Token storage backend: auto, keychain, or file.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_PROVENANCE_TAG
config.description: Extended-property tag name for MCP-created events; empty disables provenance tagging.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_MAIL_ENABLED
config.description: Enable read-only mail access and request the Mail.Read scope.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_MAIL_MANAGE_ENABLED
config.description: Enable draft management and request the Mail.ReadWrite scope; implies MAIL_ENABLED.

config.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_BYTES
config.description: Maximum attachment size in bytes returned by get_attachment (default 10 MB).
